checks.text: On a finished order, the buyer's phone shows as stars
And the address shows as stars
The page says why: the details are hidden once an order is finished

shots.caption: The order just sent: still "On the way", so the buyer's details are still shown

notes: While an order is still on its way, the seller needs the phone and address, so they are shown in full. They are masked only when the order is finished.
did: Accepted an order and marked it sent, then looked at the buyer's phone and address again.
